name: Mandibola (Prototype)
source:
A girl who despises humanity remains trapped in an infinite dream-death loop to ascend to the path of the divine... a death angel will guide her (in her own ways) to the right path, Liebe (protagonist) will have a love-hate situation with Maude (the angel). 

Will she love or hate the angel?

Free on Itch.io to try
https://sharkatto.itch.io/mandibola-demo
